Cause: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:23 does LOG_MODULE_REGISTER(coap_oscore, ...) while oscore_ctx.c:23, oscore_protect.c:22 and oscore_replay.c:17 do LOG_MODULE_DECLARE(oscore, ...) - the declared module name 'oscore' is never registered anywhere, so on v4.1.0's logging (per-name symbols) the reference dangles. Blocks runtime testing of every oscore test app on v4.1.0 (lichen/tests/oscore, oscore_persist, oscore_schc_roundtrip, coap_oscore_fallback, coap_keys). new_value: Log module mismatch fixed: (1) coap_oscore.c REGISTER renamed coap_oscore -> oscore (the bead's one-token fix - 3 sibling files DECLARE oscore and the old name was never registered, dangling log_const_oscore on v4.1.0's per-name log symbols); (2) verification surfaced a second config hole - coap_oscore.c is zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_COAP_SERVER), so apps without the CoAP server (lichen/tests/oscore) had NO registration at all. Final design (reviewer-recommended over an initial #ifdef): oscore_ctx.c (always compiled) unconditionally REGISTERs oscore; coap_oscore.c DECLAREs like its siblings - exactly one registration by construction in every config, no C<->CMake coupling. Verified on heft (native_sim/native/64, v4.1.0 workspace, -DZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES): =n config (tests/oscore) links and full ztest suite PASSES (rfc8613_vectors etc., PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL - previously failed to link); =y config (tests/coap_oscore_fallback) links and 'oscore: OSCORE initialized' proves single registration + correct name (its remaining runtime failures are suite_setup network binding on native_sim, pre-existing v4.1.0 coap test-infra cluster, filed as 8i6s - log changes cannot affect socket binds). cppcheck clean. 3x codereview (correctness/security/robustness, reviewer-model passes): config matrix verified (LICHEN_OSCORE=y/n x COAP_SERVER=y/n, exactly one registration in every reachable config; no other shared-DECLARE latent instances repo-wide after dependency check; no log-name consumers in tree); reviewer-recommended unconditional-REGISTER simplification adopted over my initial #ifdef design.
